mapper.insert: INSERT INTO player_stats_watch (id, mode, subserver, active, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{mode}, #{subserver}, #{active}, NOW()) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = new.active, updated_at = new.updated_at

INSERT INTO player_stats_watch (id, mode, subserver, active, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.mode}, #{item.subserver}, #{item.active}, NOW())
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active = new.active, updated_at = new.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.osu_user_id AS user_id, m.mode FROM osu_account a INNER JOIN lazybot_user u ON u.id = a.lazybot_user_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT 0 AS mode UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 ) m LEFT JOIN player_stats_watch w ON w.id = a.osu_user_id AND w.mode = m.mode AND w.subserver = #{subserver} WHERE a.server = 'bancho' AND u.enabled = 1 AND a.osu_user_id IS NOT NULL AND (w.active IS NULL OR w.active = 1)
